title: Career roadmap · Professor
summary: An academic career combining deep-tech entrepreneurship research, innovation studies, technology commercialisation, teaching, publications, grants, doctoral supervision and university–industry engagement.

facts.Timeline assumption: 2026 is treated as Ph.D. Year 1. The roadmap assumes the student is building both a rigorous research profile and practical expertise in entrepreneurship, innovation management and deep-tech commercialisation. Academic appointment criteria vary by institution and discipline.

Career progression

Ph.D. Researcher → Research Fellow/Postdoctoral Researcher → Assistant Professor
2030–2035: Assistant Professor → Independent Researcher → Research Grant Principal Investigator
2035–2040: Associate Professor → Research Group Lead → Centre/Programme Director
2040–2046: Professor → Research Centre Director / Department Head → Dean / Academic Innovation Leader
PhD routes
Further research after this Ph.D. could focus on:

The long-term academic objective should be to own a distinctive research agenda rather than simply accumulate publications. A strong professor in this field can combine high-quality scholarship with funded research, doctoral supervision, executive education, industry partnerships, university incubators and technology-commercialisation projects. By 2040–2046, the strongest profile would combine international research visibility with leadership of a research centre, entrepreneurship ecosystem or university innovation programme.
